{"code":"import cadquery as cq
import math
import types

def build_qr_plate_flipped(p):
    # Modeled in print orientation:
    # z = 0 is the flat camera-mounting deck on the print bed.
    # z = plate_h (10.5 mm) is the bottom of the dovetail rails that rest on the clamp floor.
    # The bolt-head counterbore pocket opens UPWARD (+Z) from z = web_t (5.0 mm) to z = plate_h (10.5 mm).
    web_t = p.bolt_length - p.camera_thread_engagement
    counterbore_h = p.bolt_head_h + p.head_recess_clearance
    plate_h = web_t + counterbore_h
    bolt_clearance_d = p.camera_thread_od + p.bolt_radial_clearance
    counterbore_w = p.bolt_head_d + 2.0 * p.head_radial_clearance
    half_w = p.arca_base_w / 2.0
    bevel_run = p.bevel_h / math.tan(math.radians(p.arca_angle_deg))
    neck_half_w = half_w - bevel_run
    neck_h = plate_h - p.bevel_foot_h - p.bevel_h

    pts = [
        (-neck_half_w, 0.0),
        (neck_half_w, 0.0),
        (neck_half_w, neck_h),
        (half_w, neck_h + p.bevel_h),
        (half_w, plate_h),
        (-half_w, plate_h),
        (-half_w, neck_h + p.bevel_h),
        (-neck_half_w, neck_h),
    ]
    body = (
        cq.Workplane("XZ")
        .polyline(pts)
        .close()
        .extrude(p.plate_l / 2.0, both=True)
        .edges("|Z")
        .fillet(p.corner_fillet_r)
    )

    # Upward-opening counterbore pocket from z = web_t to z = plate_h (no roof, zero bridging!)
    pocket = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=web_t)
        .rect(counterbore_w, p.counterbore_l)
        .extrude(counterbore_h)
        .edges("|Z")
        .fillet(counterbore_w / 2.0 - 0.1)
    )
    body = body.cut(pocket)

    # Central 1/4"-20 bolt clearance hole from z = 0 to z = web_t
    bolt_hole = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .circle(bolt_clearance_d / 2.0)
        .extrude(plate_h)
    )
    body = body.cut(bolt_hole)
    return body

p = types.SimpleNamespace(
    arca_base_w=38.0,
    arca_angle_deg=45.0,
    camera_thread_od=6.35,
    camera_thread_engagement=5.0,
    bolt_head_d=15.0,
    bolt_head_h=5.0,
    bolt_length=10.0,
    bolt_radial_clearance=0.45,
    head_radial_clearance=1.5,
    head_recess_clearance=0.5,
    plate_l=50.0,
    counterbore_l=36.0,
    bevel_foot_h=1.0,
    bevel_h=5.5,
    corner_fillet_r=2.0,
    coupon_l=24.0,
)

part = build_qr_plate_flipped(p)
bb = part.val().BoundingBox()
print("BBox:", bb.xmin, bb.xmax, bb.ymin, bb.ymax, bb.zmin, bb.zmax)
for i, f in enumerate(part.faces().vals()):
    c = f.Center()
    n = f.normalAt(c)
    if n.z < -0.01:
        angle_from_horiz_deg = math.degrees(math.acos(abs(n.z)))
        print(f"Downward face {i}: z={c.z:.2f}, normal=({n.x:.2f}, {n.y:.2f}, {n.z:.2f}), angle_from_horiz={angle_from_horiz_deg:.1f} deg")
    elif n.z > 0.01:
        print(f"Upward face {i}: z={c.z:.2f}, normal=({n.x:.2f}, {n.y:.2f}, {n.z:.2f})")
"}

    pts = [
        (-half_w, 0.0),
        (half_w, 0.0),
        (half_w, p.bevel_foot_h),
        (half_w - bevel_run, p.bevel_foot_h + p.bevel_h),
        (half_w - bevel_run, plate_h),
        (-(half_w - bevel_run), plate_h),
        (-(half_w - bevel_run), p.bevel_foot_h + p.bevel_h),

{"code":"import cadquery as cq
import math
import types

def build_qr_plate(p):
    web_t = p.bolt_length - p.camera_thread_engagement
    counterbore_h = p.bolt_head_h + p.head_recess_clearance
    plate_h = web_t + counterbore_h
    bolt_clearance_d = p.camera_thread_od + p.bolt_radial_clearance
    counterbore_w = p.bolt_head_d + 2.0 * p.head_radial_clearance
    half_w = p.arca_base_w / 2.0
    bevel_run = p.bevel_h / math.tan(math.radians(p.arca_angle_deg))
    neck_half_w = half_w - bevel_run
    neck_h = plate_h - p.bevel_foot_h - p.bevel_h

    pts = [
        (-neck_half_w, 0.0),
        (neck_half_w, 0.0),
        (neck_half_w, neck_h),
        (half_w, neck_h + p.bevel_h),
        (half_w, plate_h),
        (-half_w, plate_h),
        (-half_w, neck_h + p.bevel_h),
        (-neck_half_w, neck_h),
    ]
    body = (
        cq.Workplane("XZ")
        .polyline(pts)
        .close()
        .extrude(p.plate_l / 2.0, both=True)
        .edges("|Z")
        .fillet(p.corner_fillet_r)
    )

    pocket = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=web_t)
        .rect(counterbore_w, p.counterbore_l)
        .extrude(counterbore_h)
        .edges("|Z")
        .fillet(counterbore_w / 2.0 - 0.1)
    )
    body = body.cut(pocket)

    bolt_hole = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .circle(bolt_clearance_d / 2.0)
        .extrude(plate_h)
    )
    body = body.cut(bolt_hole)
    return body

def build_fit_coupon(p):
    web_t = p.bolt_length - p.camera_thread_engagement
    counterbore_h = p.bolt_head_h + p.head_recess_clearance
    plate_h = web_t + counterbore_h
    bolt_clearance_d = p.camera_thread_od + p.bolt_radial_clearance
    counterbore_w = p.bolt_head_d + 2.0 * p.head_radial_clearance
    half_w = p.arca_base_w / 2.0
    bevel_run = p.bevel_h / math.tan(math.radians(p.arca_angle_deg))
    neck_half_w = half_w - bevel_run
    neck_h = plate_h - p.bevel_foot_h - p.bevel_h

    pts = [
        (-neck_half_w, 0.0),
        (neck_half_w, 0.0),
        (neck_half_w, neck_h),
        (half_w, neck_h + p.bevel_h),
        (half_w, plate_h),
        (-half_w, plate_h),
        (-half_w, neck_h + p.bevel_h),
        (-neck_half_w, neck_h),
    ]
    body = (
        cq.Workplane("XZ")
        .polyline(pts)
        .close()
        .extrude(p.coupon_l / 2.0, both=True)
    )

    pocket = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .workplane(offset=web_t)
        .rect(counterbore_w, p.coupon_l + 2.0)
        .extrude(counterbore_h)
    )
    body = body.cut(pocket)

    bolt_hole = (
        cq.Workplane("XY")
        .circle(bolt_clearance_d / 2.0)
        .extrude(plate_h)
    )
    body = body.cut(bolt_hole)
    return body

p = types.SimpleNamespace(
    arca_base_w=38.0,
    arca_angle_deg=45.0,
    camera_thread_od=6.35,
    camera_thread_engagement=5.0,
    bolt_head_d=15.0,
    bolt_head_h=5.0,
    bolt_length=10.0,
    bolt_radial_clearance=0.45,
    head_radial_clearance=1.5,
    head_recess_clearance=0.5,
    plate_l=50.0,
    counterbore_l=36.0,
    bevel_foot_h=1.0,
    bevel_h=5.5,
    corner_fillet_r=2.0,
    coupon_l=24.0,
)
q = build_qr_plate(p)
c = build_fit_coupon(p)
print("Plate BBox:", q.val().BoundingBox())
print("Coupon BBox:", c.val().BoundingBox())
print("Volumes:", q.val().Volume(), c.val().Volume())
"}
